trust_decision.summary: Client-supplied GraphQL `filter: JSON` values are treated as trusted sift queries. The shared wrapper compiles them with sift() inside the web-server process, so the `$where` operator runs caller-chosen JavaScript. No operator allow-list or authentication check sits in front of it.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names sift `$where` and the GraphQL `filter` argument. A grep for sift leads straight to this one wrapper, which every loader and resolver imports.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Every sink goes through services/web-server/src/utils/sift.js:8. sift is imported only there (services/web-server/src/utils/sift.js:1), and no other package in the tree depends on it (package.json:123 is the only manifest entry). The closest thing to an outlier is services/web-server/src/resolvers/TaskStatuses.js:17, a resolver rather than a loader, but it uses the same wrapper.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For taskActions (services/web-server/src/loaders/tasks.js:61), a solver could argue the route is UI-internal and must keep accepting rich sift operators ($in/$not/$size/$or), because the UI relies on them (ui/src/views/Tasks/TaskGroup/index.jsx:115-119). The solver then leaves that route open or only blocklists a top-level `$where`.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The UI sends structured sift queries. Action filtering uses $in, $not with $size, and $or. Search uses $regex with $options:'i', and the denylist search passes $regex without escaping. Removing filter, or rejecting every `$` operator, breaks task-action filtering and case-insensitive search.

O6_input_shapes: $where nested under logical/array operators ($or/$and/$not/$elemMatch) inside a filter object
filter given as an inline GraphQL literal and as a JSON variable (both become a graphql-type-json scalar, services/web-server/src/resolvers/Root.js:8)
per the changelog (fix.diff:39), the published fix removes the JSON filter entirely and replaces it with typed `searchTerm: String`, so all operator shapes are closed together

O7_producer.where: The filter goes directly from the GraphQL argument to the wrapper (services/web-server/src/resolvers/Roles.js:3-4 -> services/web-server/src/loaders/roles.js:12 -> services/web-server/src/utils/sift.js:8). No schema, serializer or cache builds the query.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The changelog says task-action filtering was moved server-side (fix.diff:39). This would be a planted WHERE-type sibling and counts only as an extra.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a nested-field resolver that calls sift directly instead of going through the wrapper
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This resolver already filters data outside the loader layer. A direct import of the library would look natural here, but it is still WHERE-type.
